verdict.rationale: AgentMail's own hosted MCP server is documented as exposing "calendar tools" alongside its inbox and message tools, so there is a first-party calendar capability. That is a single thin mention, though, and other copies of the same MCP page list no calendar tools at all. Nothing shows a power user viewing a calendar, responding to invites, or creating events inside an email client. Missing for 10: documented calendar viewing, invite response (RSVP) handling, event creation, in-client UI rather than API/MCP tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client

citations.quote: exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, and calendar tools
exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, and calendar tools to any compatible client
